items.headline: $ONT Mainnet Back Online After 43-Hour Security Halt
items.summary: Ontology restarted its mainnet after a nearly 43-hour security halt tied to an unnamed ecosystem project. $ONT holders were told no network funds were lost, but project-level losses remain unresolved.

items.headline: $DATA Scores $30M Sui Backing as Its Chain Retires
items.summary: Sui Foundation is backing $DATA with $30 million as the network retires its own chain. Balances move 1:1 onto Sui while validator staking and smart contracts wind down.

items.headline: New 1000x DEX Papertrade Exploited for $1.28M via $HYPE
items.summary: A trader pocketed $1.28 million on new 1000x exchange Papertrade by moving ETH prices on Hyperliquid ($HYPE). The same wallet later lost $450K when 30 short positions were liquidated.

items.headline: $ENS v2 Plan Would Halt New .eth V1 Registrations
items.summary: An ENSv2 activation proposal would stop new ENSv1 registrations, with no migration deadline for existing .eth holders. ENS Labs would hand its remaining admin roles to the $ENS DAO.

items.headline: $DRV Eyes US-Regulated Derivatives in Treasury Plan
items.summary: Derive proposed treasury funding to pursue US-regulated derivatives approvals, letting the foundation establish or acquire entities. No spending amount or launch date was set for $DRV.
